ORce6ab9ddc7e85956.content: Raja Nilkanth Narain Singh mortgaged Gadi Sirampur to Chota Nagpur Banking Association Limited on 1st August, 1914. The Bank obtained a mortgage decree on 29th November, 1921, and purchased a third share on 28th October, 1922.

OR330a5ea791128a36.content: During proceedings, on 5th November, 1925, Wazir Narain Singh granted a permanent lease of four villages to Hiraman Ram (Manager and Karta of joint Hindu family) and his son Chohan Ram.
OR330a5ea791128a36.event: Permanent lease granted during mortgage suit pendency
OR330a5ea791128a36.procedure_and_court: Court of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh

ORd073ac5bda354893.content: An agreement was made that if Wazir Narain Singh paid Rs. 1,10,631-4-0 by 16th August, 1926, the sale would be set aside. He executed a mortgage on 14th August, 1926, to Court of Wards to satisfy dues and set aside the sale.
ORd073ac5bda354893.event: Sale set aside and new mortgage executed

ORbd32a326d11ad789.content: Plaintiff (through Court of Wards) filed suit on 4th February, 1929 to enforce mortgage, impleading Hiraman Ram and Dilo Ram as defendants. Final decree for sale passed 18th September, 1931; Plaintiff purchased on 6th April, 1935.

ORf5740e0a8d983482.content: Dilo Ram died after mortgage decree. Hiraman Ram and Chohan Ram continued possession. Plaintiff filed suit on 16th November, 1939 for khas possession against Hiraman Ram and Chohan Ram.
ORf5740e0a8d983482.procedure_and_court: Court of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh

OR9d4f71c9c414509f.content: Denied plaintiff was subrogated to Bank's position; argued decree not binding as he was not a party; Patta not ended by auction sale; alleged partition within a year after possession allotted properties to him.

ORd284328f5a7b7a08.content: Held plaintiff subrogated to Bank's position; Defendant 1 was Manager/Karta; Defendant 2 fully represented; decree binding; plaintiff entitled to possession and mesne profits.

participants.role: Court of Additional Subordinate Judge of Hazaribagh

OR8fe091da7d11c994.speaker_label: High Court of Judicature at Patna
OR8fe091da7d11c994.content: Negatived constructive res judicata contention. Considered if Wazir Narayan Singh had power to grant permanent lease. Concluded lease did not render Bank's security insufficient; held lease valid; dismissed plaintiff's suit.

participants.name_or_role: High Court of Judicature at Patna

OR8fe091da7d11c994.event: High Court judgment dismissing plaintiff's suit
OR8fe091da7d11c994.procedure_and_court: High Court of Judicature at Patna

OR3482bef38045cdad.content: Obtained leave to appeal to Privy Council from High Court decision; appeal admitted on 9th January, 1946.

OR5ff86d6ebad5e212.content: Found plaintiff subrogated to Bank's position and Defendant 2 sufficiently represented; only surviving question is whether Wazir Narayan Singh had power to grant permanent lease to bind plaintiff.
OR5ff86d6ebad5e212.event: Privy Council identifies sole legal question
